text:
Lina Torres: dropping a quick prototype for the latency card + sampler preset menu. need eyes on focus order + contrast. https://figma.com/file/abc123
Owen Lee: Looks good. small ask: when sampler dropdown opens, focus should land on the currently active preset, not the top. keyboard users expect that.
Rhea Sundar: Agree. Also the preset labels: 'Auto', 'Live', 'Archive' are shorthand but ambiguous. Proposal: 'Auto (adaptive)', 'Live (100%)', 'Archive (10%)'.
Lina Torres: nice, explicit percentages help. what about the toggle copy under the time-range: currently "Reduce sampling for long ranges" — sounds passive. maybe "Lower sampling for long ranges to improve responsiveness"?
Tom Beckett: prefer shorter: "Lower sampling for long ranges" then a tooltip with more detail.
a11y-bot: Contrast scan: the dim label color (#6B7280) fails AA against white at 12px. Recommend #374151 or bump font weight.
Rhea Sundar: Can we use the same microcopy style as other banners? e.g., lead with impact then action. "Long range selected — lowering sampling to keep preview responsive." Then button 'Change sampling'.
Owen Lee: UX question: when sampling is lowered, should the heatmap annotation show "sampled" overlay? I worry users won't realize they're seeing partial data.
Lina Torres: Yes — show a subtle pill in the top-left of the card: "Sampled view — 10%" with an info chevron. Click opens explanation modal.
Tom Beckett: For p95 tooltip, suggestion: show both aggregation window and raw value. Eg "p95 (1m window): 420ms". Helps users understand smoothing.
Rhea Sundar: small implementation note: keep the tooltip small. One line for the label, one line for the value, link for "how this is computed".
a11y-bot: Keyboard flow test: recommended tab order -> timepicker start, timepicker end, sampler toggle, preset menu, chart canvas. Ensure the sampled-pill is reachable via keyboard and has aria-describedby pointing to explanation.
Lina Torres: CSS focus snippet for the pill I propose:
```
.sampled-pill:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.25);
  border-radius: 6px;
}
```
Owen Lee: Colorblind palette for heatmap: try Viridis or a diverging purple->amber scale, keep mid value visible.
Tom Beckett: If we add sparklines in the legend, keep height to 18px, no axis labels, accessible title text for screen readers: "p95 trend, last 24h".
Rhea Sundar: Copy tweak for the sampler modal header: change from "Sampling" to "Sampling & Preview fidelity" — clarifies scope.
Lina Torres: Nice. I'll update the figma with these copy changes and attach an interaction spec for keyboard focus.
img-bot: Uploaded: designs/latency/sampler-presets-and-pill.png
Lina Torres: thanks, will ping once next iteration is ready for a11y review.
